craft_notes: Sthāyin: raudra-vīra of the cremation ground — Rauhine register throughout: broken-middle-drunk → gore teaches → brow burns → sky speaks → parted freed. Tied-aimed spread; ever-are hinge; api concessive per UNC. Rejected: (a) stained-gone→unstained → killed: gone-ness moves. Read aloud: IN-ward TIED-aimed … DE-lu-sion-STAINED-gone SELF.

lines: Inward tied-aimed, faculties spread — though You ever are —
that shown in every state — delusion-stained-gone self.
l4.sanskrit_cite: antarnibaddhalakṣyaḥ pravikāsikaraṇo 'pi yat sadā bhavasi tat prathayasi sarvadaśaṃ gatamohakalaṅkam ātmānam

reads_against.argmap: How aim inward-bound? → Bound-aimed expanding shows all-states unstained self.
c1_essence: Egg-middled saps drunk; shown within as-if.
Rosary held turns world within by letters.
Bubbles jar; brow-eye burning taught supreme-fire.
Aimed inward expanding shows unstained self all-states.
Sky-clad speaks bare; veil questioned covering.
Destroyer shown gleaming-bodied from dark ground.
